Your Medicaid or CHIP benefits may be delayed if your state agency needs you to send documents to
confirm information. If your state says you’re not eligible for Medicaid or CHIP, it will tell you how you
can appeal the decision.
Can I appeal now?      The “Next Steps” section of your Eligibility Notice will tell you if you can appeal your results with the
Marketplace Appeals Center now. Your eligibility determination isn’t final if the “Next Steps” section of your
notice says that someone needs to submit documents.
